--- revoke_queue.sql
REVOKE DELETE ON QUEUE Q FROM ROLE consumer

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnQueue{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.DeletePrivilege{
        Delete: 7,
      },
    },
    Names: []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 23,
            NameEnd: 24,
            Name:    "Q",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 35,
      NameEnd: 43,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE DELETE ON QUEUE Q FROM ROLE consumer
